svg.title: EEG analysis pipeline — stages 7 to 12
svg.desc: Chronological single-column flowchart of the rebuilt EEG pipeline from model training through to final reporting

g.text: Trains RF per participant, per feature set, per seed
Uses locked best_params from grid_search.py — no re-tuning
Outputs: per-participant accuracy matrix across seeds + confusion matrices
Primary result: full-set mean acc; secondary: frontal vs temporal ablation
Runs EI on balanced data with identical CV protocol as RF
This is the fix: same evaluation protocol = valid comparison to RF
Outputs: per-participant EI accuracy + summary CSV
Reruns full RF pipeline on notch and no-notch preprocessed features
Both versions use same blocked CV — corrected evaluation only
Paired Wilcoxon across 25 participants: notch vs no-notch acc
Outputs: ablation_comparison CSV + Wilcoxon result + effect size r
Wilcoxon signed-rank across 25 participants vs 50% chance
Reports W-statistic, exact p, rank-biserial r (effect size)
Per-participant binomial CI (one-sample vs p=0.5 per trial count)
Outputs: stats_summary CSV + per-participant significance table
Extracts mean Gini importance per feature across all CV folds
Aggregates to 7-band level per participant, then across participants
Friedman test across 7 bands; pairwise Wilcoxon with Bonferroni
Flags: if TP9/TP10 features dominate, appends motor artifact warning
Outputs: full 112-feature table + 4x7 heatmap data + band test CSV
Leave-one-group-out: train on 24, test on held-out participant
Reports accuracy AND confusion matrix (not just recall)
Outputs: LOGO accuracy, confusion matrix, per-fold breakdown CSV
Outputs: master_results.csv + all thesis tables as LaTeX-ready files

svg.text: Blue = training and ablations Coral = statistics and interpretation Gray = terminal outputs
